description: Store an interaction event in short-term session memory. Used by I/O interfaces (console, JSON-RPC, Telegram, etc.) to record user inputs and system outputs for conversation history. Events are stored with timestamps and namespace for filtering.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Interaction event stored in session memory
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Storing interaction event in session memory
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: invalid event_type or missing required fields. DatabaseError: failed to persist event to storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify event_type is 'user_input' or 'system_output'. For database errors: verify state storage is accessible.
